activity.notes: Fyodor Kharchin, rendered Harchin in the submitted list, was an Itelmen toyon and a leader of the 1731 Kamchatka uprising. The directly documented uprising year is recorded as a representative point; the interval is not extended to his 1735 execution as if he remained a free ruling chief throughout imprisonment.
